# NNumberCheck

> NNumberCheck.com is a free aircraft N-number lookup and history report service. Enter any US registration number to instantly see FAA registration details and 44 years of NTSB accident history.

## What we provide

- **Free lookup**: FAA registration data for any of 317,218 US-registered aircraft
- **Accident history**: 87,978 NTSB accident records from 1982 to present
- **Full history report**: Detailed ownership, accident, and airworthiness information for $149

## Data sources

- FAA Releasable Aircraft Database (public domain, updated daily)
- NTSB Aviation Accident Reports (public domain, 1982–present)

## Key pages

- [Home](https://nnumbercheck.com/): Search any N-number for free
- [About](https://nnumbercheck.com/about): What NNumberCheck does and why
- [Privacy](https://nnumbercheck.com/privacy): How we handle data
- [Terms](https://nnumbercheck.com/terms): Terms of service
- [Disclaimer](https://nnumbercheck.com/disclaimer): Important data limitations

## Coverage

- 317,218 aircraft in the FAA registry
- 87,978 NTSB accident records
- Date range: 1982-01-01 through present
